data.why: The repo bundles a small synthetic Streptomyces demo genome/annotation/BGC-region set under examples/ that the app's own --demo mode and upload widgets are built around, so copies are handed to the browser as upload files rather than invented.

goals: Design and score sgRNA guides against a target gene in a microbial genome using an organism-specific profile
Screen candidate guides for off-target hits elsewhere in the genome
Evaluate CRISPRi feasibility (promoter/start-codon proximity) for a target gene
Screen top guides for base-editing feasibility (editable bases, predicted codon/AA changes)
Tag guides overlapping known biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) regions for context
Export a shareable CSV/Excel/HTML report of the final guide design and save it to a local project database

review.summary: A well-shaped, honest tree: the four phases track the real stages of the work, the general labels are clean of the tool's vocabulary, and the blocked paths (upload handler crash, uninitialised SQLite DB, CLI-only base editing) are documented rather than hidden. It needs fixing before filing because it states as interface facts two things that were artifacts of one never-reloaded page — that the guide table and summary never render and that results can only be read from downloads — which the replay contradicts, and because several content claims are cited to screenshots that show only a download button.
